data.name: Vibhavat
data.gender_notes: Vibhavat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vibhavat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vibhava', which refers to the manifestation or appearance of a deity. The name Vibhavat carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vibhavat usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who embodies the divine power and presence.
data.etymology: Vibhavat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhavat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: King Vibhavatibhatta I (ruled 1231-1252 CE) of the Solanki dynasty in Gujarat, India, was an accomplished ruler and patron of the arts.

Vibhavatipura, also known as Vibhavatikonda or Vibhavatikonda Sivarama, was a hill fortress located in the present-day Andhra Pradesh, India, and was the capital city of the Eastern Chalukya Empire during the 11th century CE.
